title: Validate the iHRIS knowledge graph
description: Checks every ihris-* node against src/schemas/, every folio-catalogue(-node)/v1 file and Tool node against folio-assistant's own zod schemas (from the mounted folio-assistant-core and cat-harness), and that metadataRef, module parent/formClasses and releaseFile references resolve.

install.cli: pip install jsonschema; src/tools/mount_platform.sh (mounts folio-assistant-core and its closure from index.lock.json, then bun install)
